title: P0.25: Launcher/Startup State Sovereignty
description: Extend the universal OBSERVE loop backwards to the launcher. Before P0.25, if VBS/PowerShell/lock handling failed before Python bootstrap, RuntimeAuditTracer never existed and IABV could not learn from a failed birth.
reason: Live evidence showed d82cd22a code installed, but double-click startup created iabv_start.lock without a new runtime_build_fingerprint. Old hidden start_iabv.ps1/run_mcp_bridge.ps1 processes existed, and startup_console/runtime_audit did not move. The blind spot was below Python.
next_action: Use the live startup evidence to continue with the next runtime slice: tunnel/process hygiene and external ChatGPT consultation proof. Do not reopen P0.25 unless startup_audit or runtime_handoff regress.
resume_hint: P0.25 adds startup_audit.jsonl from start_iabv.ps1, removes silent VBS lock exits, releases iabv_start.lock before the long-running bridge, and connects startup_audit into RuntimeAuditTracer, OSES, and PortableContext.
